rules.sentence: The true etiology of osteosarcoma is unknown.
Osteosarcoma of the jaw has a later onset, is more commonly low-grade, has a reduced risk of metastasis, and better overall prognosis.
Tumor suppressor genes p53 and RB1 mutations are thought to be involved in tumor initiation.[21]
An environment of rapid bond growth is thought to increase risk, accounting for the increased incidence of osteosarcoma in Paget disease.
Additionally, environmental factors such as ionizing radiation and chromic oxide have increased the risk of osteosarcoma.[22][23]
